audience: training managers and HR teams who run online courses in TalentLMS

useCases.title: Check portal totals and recent activity
useCases.text: The AI reads portal totals, such as users, courses and monthly active users, and the recent timeline of logins, course completions and changes.

useCases.title: See how far learners are in a course
useCases.text: The AI lists the users of a course with completion status, percentage, date and total time, and reads one user's progress and score in a course.

useCases.title: Check what a user has completed and earned
useCases.text: The AI lists a user's courses with role, completion status and score, and the certificates the user has earned.

useCases.title: List the members of groups and branches
useCases.text: The AI lists groups and branches and the users in each, with login, name, email, status and last login.

useCases.title: Create a learner and enroll them in a course
useCases.text: The AI creates a new learner account and enrolls an existing user in a course. The portal may email the new user.

useCases.title: Add a user to a group
useCases.text: The AI adds an existing user to a group, which also enrolls the user in the group's courses.
